description: This PHP source file defines the ByIdFilter class, which implements the ByIdFilterInterpreter interface. It constructs a SQL 'IN' filter string based on provided identifiers, using a database manager for quoting identifiers. The class is part of the SuiteCRM JSON API filters, specifically for interpreting 'by ID' filters.
